name: Loss Accumulation Guided (LAG) Densification
definition: A densification strategy that uses accumulated reconstruction loss maps to identify under-reconstructed regions, preventing unnecessary Gaussian growth in well-reconstructed areas.
summary: Loss Accumulation Guided densification is a 3D Gaussian Splatting strategy that uses accumulated reconstruction loss maps to prevent unnecessary Gaussian growth in well-reconstructed areas, reducing Gaussian count and training time.
